metadata.title: High-Contrast Monochrome Portrait with Custom Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A stark black-and-white side profile portrait featuring heavy chiaroscuro lighting and custom distorted typography in the negative space.
triggerTerms: black background portrait with white text

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white composition where a male subject's profile emerges from deep shadow on the right, balanced by stylized, vertically-stretched typography in the upper-left negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject profile anchored to the right edge
Deep black negative space occupying the left half
Typography positioned in the upper-left quadrant
High-contrast lighting emphasizing skin texture and tattoos
coreInvariants: Chiaroscuro lighting leaving half the face in total shadow
Distorted, hand-drawn aesthetic for primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Right-aligned side profile, cropped at the neck and back of the head, occupying approximately 50% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The highlighted bridge of the nose and the detailed rose tattoo on the cheek.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright typography in the top left, moves across the dark void to the lit profile on the right, then down to the smaller text and advisory logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant solid black void on the left side, providing a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for typography and highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and tattoo details
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between pure black and pure white.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke thickness with rough edges
Hand-drawn, slightly irregular baseline for secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: S-curves are exaggerated into liquid-like drips
Vertical stems have a vibrating or melting effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Distorted decorative display paired with a simpler, monolinear handwritten subtitle.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory block in bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the distorted, flame-like aesthetic of the primary text.
Matches the secondary handwritten text style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white side profile portrait of a man with face tattoos, lit from the side so half the face is in deep shadow, against a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn, vertically distorted outlined lettering in the top left negative space, with a smaller monolinear handwritten subtitle directly beneath it.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the left half of the image primarily black negative space?
Does the text have a distorted, wavy, or melting appearance?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the skin texture grain
Degree of vertical distortion in the lettering
Ratio of negative space to subject

mustAchieve: Sharp contrast between highlights and shadows
Legible but highly stylized custom lettering
Visible skin and tattoo detail in the lit areas

postGenerationChecks: Check that the background is pure black (#000000).
Ensure the text is white and clearly separated from the subject.
Verify the profile is facing into the negative space.
Confirm the lettering maintains a 'hand-drawn' rather than 'digital' feel.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a chiaroscuro side-profile portrait with vertically distorted, outlined display typography placed in the resulting negative space.
